accepted.question_text: Let W be a Coxeter group generated by elements s_i with length function |w|, let L: W -> N be a weight function that is positive away from the identity and additive on length-additive products, let A = Z[v, v^{-1}], and let H be the Iwahori-Hecke algebra over A with basis {T_w : w in W}, quadratic relations (T_{s_i} + v^{-L(s_i)})(T_{s_i} - v^{L(s_i)}) = 0, and multiplication T_w T_{w'} = T_{ww'} whenever |ww'| = |w| + |w'|. For x, y, z in W define structure constants f_{x,y,z} in A by T_x T_y = sum_{z in W} f_{x,y,z} T_z. Does there exist an integer N >= 0, independent of x, y, and z, such that v^{-N} f_{x,y,z} belongs to Z[v^{-1}] for every x, y, z in W?

evidence.quote: this is the Iwahori-Hecke algebra associated to W, L.
For x, y, z in W we define fx,y,z ∈ A, hx,y,z ∈ A by TxTy = P z∈W fx,y,zTz,
(b) Show that there exists an integer N ≥ 0 such that for any x, y, z in W we have v−N fx,y,z ∈ Z[v−1].

accepted.question_text: Assume the boundedness hypothesis that there is an integer N >= 0 such that v^{-N} h_{x,y,z} is in Z[v^{-1}] for all x, y, z in W, where the basis elements c_w satisfy c_x c_y = sum_{z in W} h_{x,y,z} c_z. For each z in W, let a(z) be the unique integer >= 0 such that every h_{x,y,z} lies in v^{a(z)} Z[v^{-1}] and, for at least one pair x, y, the same coefficient h_{x,y,z} does not lie in v^{a(z)-1} Z[v^{-1}]. Define integers gamma_{x,y,z^{-1}} by h_{x,y,z} = gamma_{x,y,z^{-1}} v^{a(z)} modulo v^{a(z)-1} Z[v^{-1}]. Let J be the free abelian group with basis {t_w : w in W}, and define multiplication on basis elements by t_x t_y = sum_{z in W} gamma_{x,y,z^{-1}} t_z. Does this multiplication make J into an associative ring, not necessarily with an identity element?
accepted.context_brief: Associativity of the asymptotic Hecke algebra

evidence.quote: For x, y in W we set txty = P z∈W γx,y,z−1 tz.
(c) Show that this defines an (associative) ring structure on J (without 1 in general).

accepted.question_text: Let W be a finite Weyl group of type B_n or D_n with equal weight L(w) = |w|, let C be a conjugacy class in W, and let C_min be the elements of C of minimal length. For w in C, let N^w in A = Z[v, v^{-1}] be the trace of the A-linear map H -> H given by h -> v^{2|w|} T_w h T_{w^{-1}}, where H is the Iwahori-Hecke algebra of W. For w in C_min, N^w depends only on C. Call C positive when N^w belongs to N[v^2]. Which conjugacy classes are positive for Weyl groups of type B_n and type D_n?
accepted.context_brief: Positive conjugacy classes in types B_n and D_n

evidence.quote: We say that C is positive if N w ∈ N[v2].
(d) Make a list of all positive conjugacy classes in W assuming that W is a Weyl group of type Bn or Dn.
